experimental_procedure: 3.4.2. Syntheses of Oligomers with Even Numbers (Procedure B). To a solution of 2 mmol mono-ols and 1 mmol diacid (1,18-octadec-9-enedioic acid) in 10 mL of CHCl3 under the protection of N2, 0.4 mmol DMAP was added, followed by 2.2 mmol DCC. The reaction was carried out at room temperature overnight. The precipitated dicyclohexylurea was removed by filtration.
